messages:
Ravi Kapoor: Noticed the prompt-template editor's autocomplete uses phrasing like "insert variable" and "system instruction". Feels a bit terse and confusing to new users.
Adele Morris: Yeah especially for users who don't know the difference between 'system' and 'user' roles. We should make the suggestion text explain intent not internal labels.
Kai: Agree. Also the inline suggestion overlay is currently light-gray text only; screen readers skip it. Need accessible announcements when suggestions appear.
Ravi Kapoor: Proposed microcopy for suggestions: for role switch: "Set role: system (instructions for the assistant)" and for variables: "Insert variable: {{user_name}} (fills with requester's name)". Keep the visible token short but the tooltip/aria provides description.
Adele Morris: Love that. For variables maybe show example values in the tooltip: "Example: 'Alex'". Also add a keyboard hint: "Press Tab to accept" in the suggestion footer.
Kai: Accessibility: suggestion list should be a listbox with aria-activedescendant and the live region should announce "X suggestions available". The description strings should map to localization keys: `autocomplete.role.description`, `autocomplete.variable.description`, `autocomplete.hint.accept_tab`.
design-bot: Accessibility lint: ensure you don't use placeholder text as the only label for form controls; use aria-labels. Avoid non-descriptive link text. Make Tab hint visible to keyboard users too.
Ravi Kapoor: Final localized copy to add: 
- autocomplete.role.display = "system"
- autocomplete.role.description = "System role: instructions that guide the assistant's behavior"
- autocomplete.variable.display = "{{variable}}"
- autocomplete.variable.description = "Inserts a value at runtime. Example: 'Alex'"
- autocomplete.hint = "Press Tab to accept suggestion"
Adele Morris: One more UX nit: shorten the inline overlay to just display the display value (e.g., "system" or "{{user_name}}") and show the description in a small popup when focused. That keeps the editor clean.
Kai: I'll wire the ARIA changes and the live region. Adding telemetry `ui.autocomplete.opened` and `ui.autocomplete.accepted_method` (tab/click).
Ravi Kapoor: Great. I'll update the design tokens and push a tiny PR with copy and ARIA guidance. Thanks!
